faces.name: Memory Lapse
faces.oracleText: Counter target spell. If that spell is countered this way, put it on top of its owner's library instead of into that player's graveyard.

faces.name: Memory Leak
faces.oracleText:
Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from that player's graveyard or hand and exile it.
Cycling {1} ({1}, Discard this card: Draw a card.)

faces.name: Memory Plunder
faces.oracleText: You may cast target instant or sorcery card from an opponent's graveyard without paying its mana cost.

faces.name: Memory's Journey
faces.oracleText:
Target player shuffles up to three target cards from their graveyard into their library.
Flashback {G} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)

faces.name: Memory Sluice
faces.oracleText:
Target player mills four cards.
Conspire (As you cast this spell, you may tap two untapped creatures you control that share a color with it. When you do, copy it and you may choose a new target for the copy.)

faces.name: Memory Test
faces.oracleText:
When this Attraction enters, target opponent exiles cards from the bottom of their library until they exile five nonland cards, then turns those nonland cards face down.
Visit — Name the exiled face-down cards, then look at them. If you named them correctly, turn them face up, then claim the prize!
Prize — Create three 1/1 red Balloon creature tokens with flying, then sacrifice this Attraction and open an Attraction.

faces.name: Memory Theft
faces.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it. That player discards that card. You may put a card that has an Adventure that player owns from exile into that player's graveyard.

faces.name: Memory Trap
faces.oracleText: When this enchantment enters, exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield.
